thread:
Lena: Saw a p99 jump on /v1/completions after routing policy tweak. p50/p95 flat, p99 +210ms.
Tess: Likely sampling/provenance. Did sample_count change?
Lena: 26k -> 1.9k in the 5m window.
Aj: That's the pattern. Our t-digest rollup merges different sampling regimes and we don't surface counts.
Samir: Ops waste: pages fire and nobody knows it's sampling. Minimal proposal: show "n=1.9k" badge beside percentiles and tooltip origin=ingress-sampled, merged=220, raw=1900.
Tess: Backend: add merged_count (required), raw_count (optional), origin enum and routing_snapshot_id in rollup proto. UI: badge + low-confidence icon when merged_count < 200.
Aj: I'll add proto change + unit tests to preserve counts during t-digest downsampling.
ops-bot: ticket created "pctl-badge-and-rollup-provenance" -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4360.
Lena: Also add annotation rule: if p99 delta > 50ms and merged_count dropped > 75% annotate the series "likely sampling/routing artifact". Saves oncall time.
Tess: Agree. Plan: feature-flag the UI change then roll to internal users. Assign Aj/Samir.
Lena: Thanks, will watch the PR.
